scope: Already observed, 50 original standalone native FAST submissions. Each variant is separate. Cohort gates retain original fills; anchored replay uses only original archived proposals. No Pine native equivalence claim.

hypotheses.F0: All original FAST proposals; anchored control
hypotheses.F1: Signed body/full signal range >=0.55, zero range rejects. Rejected for adoption in separate observed native Champion A/B.
hypotheses.F2: Following contiguous close signed >=0.10 original signal ATR beyond frozen four-bar boundary; cancel close back through boundary, original stop touch or gap; compute new reference from that close
hypotheses.F3: Both completed H1/H4 proxy directional stacks agree; long close>EMA20>EMA50, short inverse. Offline HTF proxy can differ from final Pine context formula and history.
hypotheses.F4: First next 1–4 contiguous closes beyond boundary with adverse extreme within 0.15 original signal ATR; cancel close back through boundary, original stop touch or gap
hypotheses.F5: Closest forward obstacle proxy from prior confirmed swing, preceding UTC day/week extreme or prior 20-bar extreme is at or beyond archived rounded TP1 and at least one planned R.
hypotheses.F6: Two successive base-timeframe research regime labels are directional in the signal side, no gap on current bar. Proxy for Pine regime and transition state.
hypotheses.F8: Directional RSI at least 5 points away from 50 and directional two-bar close change >=0.25 signal ATR
hypotheses.F9: Decision within London 08:00–16:30 or New York 09:30–16:00 local weekdays via IANA DST; proxy if Pine session hours differ
hypotheses.F10: F3 and F7 only, fixed intersection, excludes F1

entry_policy: F2/F4 reanchor at new close and keep old stop. Require 0.8–2.4 current ATR risk and round-trip price-cost/risk <=0.2 (the replay research screen, not a Pine equivalence claim). Existing OHLC replay handles next open, tick rounding, three equal parts, locked 0.05R after TP1, 48 holding-bar timeout and stop-first. Keep filled invalid gaps and censored plans.

evaluation.chronological: UTC calendar month of original decision; unchanged gate for every month, historical descriptive slices
evaluation.holm: 16 trial family; one-sided net-R sign-flip 1000 repetitions, descriptive due dependence
